review_candidates.description: About Fluidstack We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it. We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI. We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply! How We Operate Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role. Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible. Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins. Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward. Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world. The Security Team Examples of key problems the team is working on You're securing the frontier of AI. The model weights training on our infrastructure are the most valuable and most targeted artifacts in technology, and we're standing up the compute to hold them faster than anyone ever has. A breach isn't a leak, it's the frontier walking out the door. Build the entire security program from scratch. Most leaders inherit someone else's system and spend a career patching it. Here you own it end to end, bare metal to boardroom, as we scale across continents. The industry's playbook was written for one building at a time. Vendor-managed appliances, manual process, and standards that assume a security team walks the floor. None of that survives contact with what we're building, so we build what should exist rather than buying what does. Your threat surface is measured in gigawatts. The customers running on our infrastructure are building the most consequential technology in human history, and being responsible for the physical and logical security of that work makes everything else feel small. Role Scope Design the security control plane end to end and make the architecture decisions the rest of the platform locks against, before the first campus depends on them. Build and operate that control plane at every site, on premises where resilience and bandwidth demand it, with a thin management layer in the cloud where that serves better. Own PKI, certificate lifecycle, identity integration, and automated deprovisioning, so access ends the moment employment does rather than at the next audit. Build the integrations, APIs, and monitoring that tell you a site is degrading before anyone files a ticket, on an estate adding campuses faster than any manual model can track. Reject the hand-built, appliance-per-site, vendor-managed pattern the physical security industry treats as normal, and replace it with infrastructure that is versioned, reproducible, and recoverable. Own backup, disaster recovery, and the non-production environment where changes are proven before they reach a live site. What We're Looking For The below is a starting point. We always make space for exceptional people, so if you don't fit this role exactly, tell us where you would. You've designed and run a production virtualization and clustered storage platform, and you can walk through a failover you actually tested rather than one you assumed would work. You've been the design authority on an architecture other people built against, and you can name a decision you got wrong and what it cost to unwind. You've owned database high availability and recovery, and you've restored from your own backups rather than trusting that they ran. You run PKI and certificate lifecycle as automation, so expiry is a solved problem rather than something that pages you at 2am. You've integrated identity systems so provisioning and deprovisioning happen without a human in the loop. You've replaced a vendor-managed or hand-built system with something reproducible, and you can explain what the accepted approach gets wrong and why. You write code and scripts as a normal part of the job, not as an occasional exception. Bonus: Video management and access control platforms (Genetec Security Center, Milestone, Lenel). Enterprise virtualization and clustered storage (Hyper-V, VMware vSphere, Nutanix, failover clustering). Database high availability (SQL Server Always On, clustering). Cloud management planes (AWS). Infrastructure as code (Terraform, Ansible, PowerShell DSC). We are committed to pay equity and transparency. Fluidstack is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. review_candidates.description: 该职位来源于猎聘 主要工作职责 Key Responsibilities 1. 混合云架构规划与演进。 制定并落地集团三年基础设施架构路线图，打通公有云、私有云与本地数据中心，实现资源统一纳管、统一调度、统一计量；主导关键技术选型与架构评审，控制技术栈收敛，避免按项目各建一套的烟囱式建设。 2. 弹性算力与资源池化。 建设虚拟化、容器与 Kubernetes 计算资源池，以及 GPU 池化调度能力，支撑 AI 训练推理与业务的突发需求；通过共享资源池与动态调度，把算力从「项目独占」转为「全集团共享」，实现 CPU / GPU 按需取用、按量计费，压降资源闲置率与算力交付周期。 3. 平台建设与稳定运营。 负责基础设施平台的日常运营，建立监控告警、变更管理、容量规划、故障应急与 SLA 体系；推进自动化与基础设施即代码（IaC），把重复手工操作沉淀为标准能力，持续降低人工运维占比与变更风险。 4. 安全基线建设与合规对齐。 承接本地数据中心安全能力建设，使本地安全标准对齐云上标准；落地基础设施侧的 EDR、零信任、SD-WAN 等项目，把边界防御升级为「每次访问都鉴权、每次调用都留痕」的主动免疫体系。配合 IT 内控与合规审计，确保数据分级、数据出域与访问权限全程可追溯。 5. 成本治理与 FinOps。 建立基础设施计量与可观测体系，按团队与项目划分预算和配额，对超支进行告警与限流；建立计费分摊（Chargeback & Allocation）机制，输出月度成本报告与资源选型建议；在质量不降的前提下优化实例类型、预留与按量配比、调用与采购结构，持续降低单位算力成本。 6. 业务连续性与灾备。 设计并验证多活与异地灾备方案，定期开展备份有效性验证与容灾演练，确保关键系统 RTO / RPO 达标；对单点故障与容量瓶颈建立提前识别机制。 7. 团队与供应商管理。 组建并带领基础设施团队，负责招聘、分工、绩效评价与人才梯队建设，培养「懂云、懂网、懂算力、懂成本」的复合型工程师；管理云厂商、IDC、硬件与系统集成商等关键供应商，负责商务、SLA 与交付验收。 8. 治理协同与能力输出。 建立基础设施标准规范、服务目录与自助服务能力，作为基础设施侧的统一接口，与安全合规、应用开发、业务方及财务协同；向业务与 AI 团队输出可复用的平台能力，减少重复建设与重复采购。 9. 预算编制与投资决策支持。 编制年度基础设施预算（云支出、硬件、License、带宽与运维服务），跟踪投入产出，向管理层提供架构投资、云上本地配比与自建外采的决策建议。 四、任职要求 Qualifications 项目 要求 学历 Educational Background 本科及以上，硕士优先。 专业要求 Major 计算机科学与技术、软件工程、通信工程、信息管理与信息系统等相关专业。 工作经验 Work Experience 10 年以上 IT 基础设施相关经验，其中 5 年以上团队管理经验；至少主导过一次大型混合云或数据中心架构升级、迁移项目。 资格证书 Qualification Certificate AWS / Azure / GCP 架构师认证、CKA / CKAD、ITIL 4、PMP、CISSP 等，任一为佳，非必需。 专业知识和技能 Knowledge & Skills - 熟悉主流公有云（AWS、Azure、阿里云等）的 IaaS / PaaS 产品体系与计费模型，具备混合云或多云架构设计与落地经验。 - 精通虚拟化、容器与编排（VMware / KVM / Kubernetes），熟悉 GPU 资源池化与调度（vGPU、MIG、Kubernetes device plugin、推理加速）。 - 熟悉企业网络架构：VPC、专线、云联网、SDN / SD-WAN、DNS、负载均衡与网络分段。 - 熟悉存储体系（块、文件、对象存储及备份归档）与数据库基础设施。 - 熟悉可观测性与运维体系（监控、日志、APM、告警），掌握 Terraform / Ansible 等 IaC 工具与 CI/CD。 - 掌握 FinOps 方法论：计量、配额、分摊与成本优化。 - 熟悉信息安全体系：零信任、EDR、等保与 GXP 合规、数据分级与出域管控。 能力素质 Competencies - 既能做三年架构规划，也能扎到变更与故障现场，战略与落地兼备。 - 成本意识与数据化决策习惯，用指标而非感觉管理资源与预算。 - 跨部门影响力强，能与安全、应用、业务、财务多方对齐并推动共识。 - 抗压能力强，可在多项目并行与突发故障下稳定交付。 - 有带人育人的意愿与方法，愿意沉淀标准，而不是自己兜住一切。

The role will ensure reliable operation of the Hospital Information Management System (HIMS), computers, networks, servers, databases, cyber security controls and related digital platforms. 1. Job Purpose The IT/Software Specialist will manage, support, secure and continuously improve the organisation’s information technology infrastructure and software systems. The role will ensure reliable operation of the Hospital Information Management System (HIMS), computers, networks, servers, databases, cybersecurity controls and related digital platforms across all branches. 1. Key Duties and Responsibilities A. HIMS and Software Management Administer and support the Hospital Information Management System. Configure user accounts, roles, access rights, workflows, service prices and system parameters. Support HIMS modules including registration, outpatient, inpatient, laboratory, pharmacy, radiology, theatre, billing, insurance, finance, inventory and reporting. Troubleshoot software errors and coordinate their resolution with vendors. Support integration of HIMS with laboratory equipment, imaging systems, payment platforms, insurance portals and other approved applications. Ensure the HIMS supports applicable Social Health Authority requirements and reporting processes. Test system updates and new functionality before deployment. Maintain a register of software licences, subscriptions, warranties and renewal dates. Assist management in evaluating and acquiring new software solutions. B. Technical Support Provide timely technical support to all employees and branches. Install, configure and maintain computers, printers, scanners, biometric devices, routers and other ICT equipment. Diagnose and resolve hardware, software, connectivity and user-access problems. Establish a helpdesk process and maintain records of incidents, resolutions and recurring system issues. Train employees on proper use of the HIMS, email, office applications and other digital systems. Prepare user manuals, standard operating procedures and troubleshooting guides. C. Network and Infrastructure Management Maintain the organisation’s local area networks, internet connectivity, Wi-Fi and interbranch communication systems. Monitor network performance, availability and security. Manage servers, cloud services, databases and data-storage systems. Maintain an updated ICT asset register and recommend replacement of obsolete equipment. Coordinate preventive maintenance of all ICT equipment. Ensure critical departments have appropriate backup connectivity and power protection. D. Information Security and Data Protection Implement cybersecurity controls to protect patient, financial and organisational information. Manage passwords, access rights, antivirus systems, firewalls, encryption and security updates. Monitor systems for unauthorised access, malware, data leakage and other security threats. Conduct regular user-access reviews and immediately deactivate access for separated employees. Ensure ICT operations comply with the Kenya Data Protection Act, applicable health-sector requirements and internal confidentiality policies. Investigate and document cybersecurity incidents and recommend corrective action. Conduct employee awareness training on phishing, password security, confidentiality and responsible system use. E. Backup, Recovery and Business Continuity Develop and maintain reliable data-backup procedures. Perform scheduled backups and regularly test whether backed-up information can be restored. Maintain disaster-recovery and ICT business-continuity procedures. Ensure critical systems can be recovered within approved timelines following a system failure or cyber incident. Maintain proper documentation of backup schedules, restoration tests and recovery actions. F. Reporting and Data Support Develop operational, clinical, financial and management reports from the HIMS. Support departments in extracting accurate data for decision-making. Monitor data quality, identify inconsistencies and coordinate corrective action. Prepare regular reports on system uptime, unresolved incidents, cybersecurity events, software performance and ICT assets. Support authorised statutory, regulatory and insurance reporting requirements. Maintain confidentiality and ensure information is released only to authorised persons. G. Vendor and Project Management Coordinate with HIMS vendors, internet service providers and other technology suppliers. Monitor vendor performance against contracts and service-level agreements. Participate in planning and implementing ICT projects, upgrades and system migrations. Obtain and evaluate technical quotations and advise management on ICT purchases. Maintain proper records of vendor contacts, contracts, licences and service reports. Requirements Academic and Professional Qualifications Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Information Technology, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems or a related discipline. At least three years’ relevant experience, preferably in a hospital or healthcare environment. Demonstrated experience administering HIMS, ERP, EMR or similar enterprise software. Knowledge of computer networks, databases, operating systems, cybersecurity and cloud services. Relevant professional certifications such as CCNA, CompTIA, Microsoft, ITIL, database administration or cybersecurity certification will be an added advantage. Knowledge of the Kenyan healthcare environment, SHA systems and healthcare data-protection requirements will be advantageous. 3. Required Technical Skills HIMS/EMR administration and troubleshooting. SQL databases and data extraction. Windows and, preferably, Linux operating systems. Network configuration and troubleshooting. Server, cloud and backup administration. Cybersecurity and access-control management. Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace administration. Hardware maintenance and user support. Report development and data analysis. Software testing, implementation and user training. Basic programming, scripting or application-development skills will be an added advantage. 4. Behavioural Competencies Strong analytical and problem-solving ability. High level of integrity and confidentiality. Good communication and employee-training skills. Ability to explain technical matters to non-technical users. Attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy. Ability to work under pressure and respond to urgent system incidents. Good planning, documentation and project-management skills. Customer-service orientation and ability to work collaboratively across departments. Willingness to support multiple branches and work outside normal hours when critical systems require attention. 5. Working Relationships The IT/Software Specialist will work closely with: Hospital management and branch managers. Clinical and nursing teams. Laboratory, pharmacy and radiology departments. Finance, accounts and insurance departments. Human resources, procurement and internal audit teams. HIMS vendors, internet providers and other technology partners. 6. Confidentiality The job holder will have access to confidential patient, employee, financial and organizational information. They must maintain strict confidentiality and comply with all applicable data-protection requirements, professional standards and organizational policies.
